fields.reasoning: Read the question, this change set's slice (run-brief-files, agent-invoke-template, guide-contract) and the code. run-brief-files already describes handback.md's content (the cause from rhiza ship check --json), so the format belongs here and the sibling only triggers; one writer avoids two formats. brief.md's sections follow the run-brief-files statement and its acceptance (TestBriefFiles names change set, intent, leaves with acceptance, decisions, constraints, prePushCheck, contract section), kept deterministic per the same-model-same-output constraint. internal/run/store.go keeps journals at <commondir>/rhiza/runs/<id>.jsonl and its listing skips directories, so <id>/ beside it is safe; TmpDir is removed at run end, so it cannot hold files a hand-back or later attempt reads, and per-session subfolders avoid clashes between parallel builder sessions of one leaves step. internal/workflow/workflow.go has prompt on agent steps, Role (builder, verifier, critic, fixer) and fileCheck, so invoke as prompt's alias must apply in each of those places.
fields.statement: handback.md: this change set owns the file's path, format and writer (run-brief-files ships a function that writes handback.md from a rhiza ship check --json cause, tested directly); the sibling's run-handback leaf owns triggering a hand-back and calls that writer, writing no handback.md format of its own. brief.md: deterministic Markdown, same bytes for the same model and run, with sections in this order: the change set (title, ID, intent); the leaves (handle, statement, acceptance each); decisions (statement each); constraints (statement each); check commands (rhiza.ship.prePushCheck and rhiza.ship.localGate when set, else none); the contract (a short summary of the obligations ending 'Full contract: rhiza guide contract'). Location: a durable per-run directory beside the journal, <commondir>/rhiza/runs/<run id>/, with one subdirectory per session named from its step plus, where present, its role or check, leaf and attempt (e.g. build/builder-<leaf>-1); it holds that session's brief.md, slice.json and handback.md, is kept when the run ends (unlike the run's temp folder) and is not inside any worktree. invoke and handback keys: accepted everywhere prompt is accepted today: an agent step, a leaves step's builder and verifier, a checks step's each check, critic and fixer; prompt stays an alias of invoke there, and setting both prompt and invoke on one table is refused by rhiza workflow check.
